parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module src/business/services fails to maintain a consistent abstraction and persistence boundary across its files. In src/business/services/MaintenanceService.ts, MaintenanceService reaches persistence through repository/table abstractions (VehicleTable and WorkOrderTable) and operates through domain model entities (Vehicle and WorkOrder). In contrast, src/business/services/MileageService.ts bypasses both the repository layer and domain model abstractions: MileageService injects the ORM client PrismaService directly in its constructor and executes direct Prisma queries in MileageService.record (this.prisma.mileage.create) and MileageService.averageDaily (this.prisma.mileage.findMany), while MileageService.record also bypasses the Vehicle entity and VehicleTable by accepting raw primitives (plate, km, lastServiceKm) and evaluating km - lastServiceKm >= SERVICE_INTERVAL_KM inline.

violations.message: MileageService bypasses the module's repository and domain abstractions established in MaintenanceService (which uses VehicleTable, WorkOrderTable, and the Vehicle entity) by injecting PrismaService directly to call this.prisma.mileage.create in record() and this.prisma.mileage.findMany in averageDaily(), and by computing service-due logic (km - lastServiceKm >= SERVICE_INTERVAL_KM) on raw parameters in record() rather than using the Vehicle abstraction.
